question: The average age of 23 students of a class is 41 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 42 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the net deviation method:

Age of new member = New Average + (Number of old members × Increase in Average)

⇒ Age of teacher = 42 + (23 × 1)

⇒ Age of teacher = 42 + 23 = 65

**∴ The correct answer is 65 years.**
